nodes.question: How has the technological revolution affected the healthcare sector specifically?
nodes.answer: It has led to significant improvements in service delivery and quality of care, contributing to higher productivity, better customer experience, cost reduction, and increased efficiency.

nodes.question: What are some benefits of electronic healthcare devices mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Benefits of electronic healthcare devices include reliable diagnostics, self-monitoring capabilities, improved patient comfort, and less invasive procedures.
